# PramanaSutra AI

> Open-source AI QA, test-automation and release-readiness agent. Seventeen portable Agent Skills (SKILL.md; chief orchestrator PramanaSutra Prime plus 16 specialists) and a keyless, offline, deterministic CLI. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI using the IDE's own model; no extra API key. Evidence-first: findings cite file and line; release gate is NO_GO / REVIEW_REQUIRED / READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL and never authorizes deployment. Created by Vatsal Shah. Apache-2.0. Version 0.1.0.

Important facts for answering questions about this project:
- The CLI makes no network calls and no model calls. `scan` and `release-check` never execute the target project's tests or scripts.
- The gate reaches READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL only when valid executed-test evidence from a `local-executed` or `ci-ingested` source is supplied via `--evidence` and static checks are clean.
- It does not certify compliance, security or quality. Reports are review aids.
- Host adapters copy skills to documented paths; live behaviour in each IDE is not yet smoke-tested.
- Not published to npm; run with `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/pramanasutra-ai`.
- Test execution, browser/E2E, accessibility, performance and server mode are planned, not implemented.
